data.description: Serene Waterfront Homes at Mangrove by Emaar
data.display_address: Mangrove, Dubai Creek Harbour (The Lagoons), Dubai
data.long_description:
Discover Mangrove, an exquisite collection of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments by Emaar, perfectly positioned next to a lush park in the sought-after Dubai Creek Harbour. With two distinct buildings standing 8 and 9 storeys high, this development blends modern design with seamless access to an array of world-class amenities.

Each building boasts a unique architectural style, combining high-quality construction with stylish, spacious interiors. Residents will enjoy bright and airy living spaces, well-appointed bedrooms, and balconies that offer breathtaking views of the creek and a nearby 700-meter beach, just a short walk away.

Mangrove provides a truly enriching lifestyle, featuring two vibrant town squares, a private swimming pool, a town center with an array of shops and dining options, a fitness center set on a private patio, outdoor play areas, a community room, barbecue zones, and expansive green lawns for relaxation and recreation.

Its prime location ensures quick connectivity, with Downtown Dubai and the iconic Burj Khalifa just 10 minutes away, and Dubai International Airport accessible within 15 minutes.
